requires: fresh baseline hash under watcher lock
final accepted candidate hash and byte comparison
steps: acquire existing host watcher lock and wait out the old invocation
recheck active baseline and staged candidate hashes under the lock
compare staged bytes with independently accepted bytes
back up source and state under the lock
release lock without changing the scheduler

guarantees: execute the staged path, not the active path
do not migrate or write state
probe.scope: direct staged probe only; existing cron can still run baseline

prohibitions: no live action from this manifest
no service, process, worker, swap, or monitoring-scope change
no state rollback without separate destructive approval
stop before worker-1 on any first-canary failure

rollback.source: restore source backup atomically under the same host watcher lock and verify baseline hash
rollback.state: restore only with separate destructive approval under the same lock
